item.text: I’m testing malformed-but-valid-looking snapshots next. `FileSnap` retries older snapshots only for `IOException`; an invalid extended ephemeral owner can raise a runtime exception during `DataTree.deserialize`, which would abort recovery instead of using the older snapshot.

item.text: The malformed-snapshot check reproduced a seventh defect: with extended ephemeral types enabled, an invalid owner in the newer snapshot raises `IllegalArgumentException` from `DataTree.deserialize`; `FileSnap` only catches `IOException`, so it never retries the older valid snapshot. I’m adding the evidence and repro.

## Notes / unresolved

- All seven findings are local defects demonstrated from the captured source.  The source
  implementation itself was not modified.
- F1 is a recovery-state issue in `FileSnap`; a fix would need to reset the `DataTree`
  ephemeral/container/TTL sets and the caller's session map before each retry (or discard the
  failed attempt's state).
- F2 is specific to the documented `0` boundary.  Negative values were not observed to hit
  the same divide-by-zero, but should be handled consistently with the "non-positive"
  documentation.
- F3 and F4 involve the oracle feature, which is non-default but is documented and supported
  by the source.  F4 is especially relevant when an `oraclePath` is present in a 3+ voter
  configuration.
- F5 is an independent digest/lastProcessedZxid flag combination; the source's existing
  compatibility test couples the two flags and therefore misses it.
- F6's direct storage behavior and its leader-side `TRUNC(0)` selection are executed;
  a full leader/follower cluster experiment remains possible future work.
- F7 demonstrates the `RuntimeException` escape from the fallback loop; it is separate
  from F1's `IOException` fallback state leak.
- This is a partial audit; no final claim is made that the list is exhaustive.

item.text:
The audit now documents seven reproduced findings in [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/report.md).

The new results from this continuation are:

- **F6 — `TRUNC(0)` retains data.** [FileTxnLog.truncate](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/zookeeper-server/src/main/java/org/apache/zookeeper/server/persistence/FileTxnLog.java:481) leaves the first transaction in a non-empty log. The production [ZKDatabase.truncateLog](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/zookeeper-server/src/main/java/org/apache/zookeeper/server/ZKDatabase.java:611) path also reloads existing snapshots, so snapshot and log data both survive. A mocked protocol reproduction confirmed that [LearnerHandler](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/zookeeper-server/src/main/java/org/apache/zookeeper/server/quorum/LearnerHandler.java:858) selects `TRUNC(0)` when the leader’s committed view is empty and the follower is at zxid 8. Repros: [TruncateZeroRepro.java](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/repro/truncate_zero/TruncateZeroRepro.java), [TruncateZeroDbRepro.java](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/repro/truncate_zero_db/TruncateZeroDbRepro.java), and [TruncateZeroProtocolRepro.java](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/repro/truncate_zero_protocol/org/apache/zookeeper/server/quorum/TruncateZeroProtocolRepro.java).

- **F7 — malformed snapshot aborts fallback.** [FileSnap.deserialize](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/zookeeper-server/src/main/java/org/apache/zookeeper/server/persistence/FileSnap.java:84) catches only `IOException`. An invalid extended ephemeral owner causes [DataTree.deserialize](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/zookeeper-server/src/main/java/org/apache/zookeeper/server/DataTree.java:1368) to throw `IllegalArgumentException`, so the older valid snapshot is never tried. Repro: [SnapshotRuntimeRepro.java](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/repro/snapshot_runtime/SnapshotRuntimeRepro.java).

The earlier findings remain documented: snapshot-fallback state leakage, snapshot-size zero division, non-terminating oracle revalidation, and the 3+ voter oracle election bypass, plus the digest-flag snapshot incompatibility. All commands and observed outputs are under `repro/`; the captured implementation was not modified.
